**Armorer** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increases durability of crafted armor by 25 and reduces the material cost.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Your crafted armor has improved durability and costs fewer materials. | 003440D7 | 

Before Update 60, the perk had 3 ranks. Rank 1 allowed for crafting some armor mods. Rank 2 reduced crafting cost of armor. Rank 3 increased the durability of crafted armor. As of this patch, armor mods no longer require perks for crafting.
